items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: But he appears to have a heart of gold, but a mind of Hitler.

ctx.x: Russian Jew, he was a Russian Jew. That was him. But he

appears to have a heart of gold, but a mind of Hitler. Do you understand what I'm saying? He wouldn't let up off on nothing. He wouldn't let up off on nothing. So I can only say that's all I can say about him, and God rest his soul he'll pay for his. He's dead and gone now. So my point now is that in going into the cabaret in Chicago, it was the year of 1926 that we were in Sunset because 1926 in the Sunset that's when we had the second injunction, that second letter from Nazarro going to the manager, which was…
Do you feel that Nat Nazarro held you back from being bigger than you were?
